title: fix: make model and agent description fields taller on mobile
author: MarcosFRG

gist.summary: Removed the one-row and inline minimum-height overrides from community model and prompt agent description fields. The create and edit forms now use the shared Textarea’s minimum height instead of showing only one line on Android.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses while checking a taller description field on a phone, beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with dark purple (#110518) outlines.
